shots.focal_element: Seated user wearing the white headset, pinching the air with an extended hand; controllers resting on the table
shots.typography: Only in-product UI text: small sans-serif tile labels and bold white sentence/title-case category buttons on the app library panel; no added marketing type.
shots.what_happens: Live-action medium shot of a user in an armchair doing hand-tracking gestures without controllers; by the 0:47.000 sheet frame the picture has already switched to the in-headset POV: an angled app Library panel over a stylised mountain-and-city environment, with a stylised hand reaching to tap a tile. The detector did not split this internal cut, so the shot covers both the outside view and the POV.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut on the user's pinch gesture from a warm live-action medium shot straight to a POV render of the UI panel, with a 3D hand entering frame bottom-right at the same moment, so the gesture reads as cause and the UI as effect.

shots.focal_element: App Library panel with a WhatsApp-style message notification ('Kimberly') floating above it and a stylised hand scrolling/tapping
on_screen_text: Ghostbusters: Rise of the Ghost Lord
First Person Tennis - The Real Tennis Simulator
shots.typography: In-product UI: notification card with a bold sentence-case sender name over a regular-weight message line in a clean geometric sans (possibly Meta's Optimistic, low confidence); tile labels small regular sans, centred under thumbnails.
shots.what_happens: POV of the slightly tilted Library panel: the stylised hand flicks the grid so the game tiles scroll, then pokes a tile, while a message notification sits pinned above the panel. The last sheet frame (0:49.000) already shows the next living-room scene, so the cut lands near the end of the detected range.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a rounded dark library panel with a 4-column thumbnail grid at a slight perspective over a soft environment backdrop, pop a dark pill notification (avatar + name + one-line message) above it, and animate the grid scrolling under a hand-tracked finger before a tap.

shots.focal_element: A smiling woman on the sofa handing the headset to the person beside her
shots.what_happens: Warm live-action medium shot on a sofa: one person passes the headset to another, framed between them; by the 0:50.000 sheet frame the picture is already the wide living-room shot of someone dancing in the headset while Beat Saber shows on the TV, so the cut into the next shot falls inside this detected range.
shots.build_rebuild: Use a short warm-graded handover moment (headset passed between two people on a sofa) as a social bridge between the solo UI demo and the group-play wide shot.

shots.focal_element: Player in the headset dancing/slashing mid-room, mirrored on a large TV showing Beat Saber, with two friends cheering on the sofa
shots.what_happens: Wide, sun-lit living-room shot: the player swings their arms in mixed-reality play while the TV casts the game view and the two people on the couch watch and react.
shots.build_rebuild: Frame a wide living-room shot with the casted game on the TV at frame-left, the player centre-left and the reacting audience frame-right, so one image shows the device, the game and the shared fun.

shots.focal_element: Front of the headset (three sensor pills, Meta logo) pushing in until the centre sensor fills the frame behind the centred headline
shots.transition_other: Opens on what looks like a continuation of the living-room wide (detector says 'other'; it reads as a soft cut), then the footage shrinks into a tilted rounded card that flies off over a pastel gradient
on_screen_text: Get ready for the most powerful Meta Quest yet
*Based on the graphic performance of the Qualcomm Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 platform vs the Meta Quest 2 platform.
shots.typography: Headline in bold white sans, sentence case, centred on two lines with neutral tracking; small regular-weight white legal footnote centred at the bottom; second claim 'Double the GPU power' in the same bold white sans, one line, over a chip render.
shots.what_happens: Section turn into specs: the living-room footage collapses into a tilted rounded card and exits, revealing a pastel product render of the headset front; the camera pushes into the centre sensor until it turns into a deep-indigo abstract tunnel. 'Get ready for the most powerful Meta Quest yet' holds centred, then blurs out as the camera zoom-blurs through the sensor into a dark circuit-board scene where a glowing chip appears with 'Double the GPU power'. A legal footnote stays on screen throughout.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the last footage frame down into a rotated rounded-corner card that slides off, crossfade to a 3D headset render, animate a continuous camera push-in on the centre sensor with motion blur, hold a centred bold headline, then blur it out and zoom-through into a dark chip scene where the next one-line claim fades in.
